description: Load one skill to follow it. Without `path`, returns its SKILL.md (the procedure itself) plus the list of its other files; pass `path` (e.g. "references/gotchas.md" or "scripts/check.py") to read one of those. If the skill names a backing wiki, use search/read_document on that wiki for current facts while following it. Pro skills need a Pro key; without one you get a preview and how to unlock it.

path.description: Optional file within the skill, as listed by read_skill. Defaults to SKILL.md.

name: read_skill
title: Read a skill
